title: polygonum hydropiperoides subsp. opelousanum
intro: Polygonum hydropiperoides subsp. opelousanum, commonly known as Western Water Pepper, is a plant species native to North America. It has been used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from pain, inflammation, and fever, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Western Water Pepper include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions, which contribute to its therapeutic potential. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
